product_metadata.title: NutriChef Electric Air Fryer - Low Fat Oilless and Healthy Deep Fryer Machine - Features Digital Display, Auto Timer and 4 Liter Basket - Black
features: Healthy Oil-Free Frying Alternative - Hassle-Free Simple Operation Digital Kitchen Appliance
Easy Air-Fry: Insert Food, Set the Time & Temp - Achieve Tasty & Low Fat Foods with Benefits
Tested to Prepare Significantly Healthier Foods Than Frying - Countertop Slide-Out Frying Basket
Air Circulation Convection Oven-Style Vortex for Even Cooking All Around - 60 Minute Timer
Ability to Broil, Roast, Bake, Grill & BBQ - Includes Teflon Non-Stick Coated Frying Basket
description: The NutriChef Air Fryer is your healthy oil-free frying alternative. This hassle-free cooking appliance is easy-to-use and unlocks convenient countertop food prep. Slide out the frying basket, insert your food and choose from air fry, broil, roast, bake, grill or BBQ your favorite foods. The integrated high-power heating element allows internal cooking temperatures to reach a maximum of 400 DegreeF -- for delicious and tasty results. Non-stick teflon coated cooking basket locks in the heat for thorough cooking with easy after-cleaning ability. The system has been tested to prepare significantly healthier foods than frying, all while creating the same flavorful results. It works for all types of meat, fish and vegetables, but it works especially well for perfectly cooked French fries with crispy skins. Set the time, the temp and you're ready to air fry! The NutriChef Air Fryer will help you prepare low-fat foods that taste great and help you feel good!
